integrity: A standalone Python 3 finite enumerator uses the defining Heyting residuation property; an arbitrary-m combinatorial proof is provided. Numerical tests are not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact rational probabilities are proved only for the rooted-star upset algebras with an integer number m>=1 of leaves. The no-gap conclusion concerns the displayed three-variable cotransitivity equation over all finite Heyting algebras, via this family; no general degree formula for arbitrary Heyting algebras is claimed. Priority over unindexed earlier equivalent formulations is not certified.
title: Almost-sure cotransitivity without weak excluded middle in finite Heyting stars
